items.title: Trust Is Not What It Seems — And Fraudsters Are Counting on It
items.summary: Threat actors don't need to rely on malware to breach organizations anymore. They're simply calling help desks and politely asking for access, with a little help from artificial intelligence.

items.title: Exposed to PHP2Shell? Cyber Experts Weigh in With Advice
items.summary: Fixing the critical PHP flaws is not as simple as clicking "Update." Here's how to assess your risk, and what you can do to protect yourself.

items.title: AI Tools Are Generating Massive Attacks for Little Cost
items.summary: One campaign targets 105 sites using open-weight models; in another, public models gained full domain control for $12. Cyber-defense will have to change.

items.title: Why Caribbean Threats Cascade Into Global Cyber-Risk
items.summary: The region is demonstrating what happens when exploits accelerate but assurance does not.

items.title: Cyber Insurance's New Reality: Underwriting Isn't Enough
items.summary: Rising AI, social engineering, and cloud risks are pushing carriers beyond risk transfer and deeper into cybersecurity itself.

items.title: AI Agents as Insider Threats: Inside Microsoft's Bet on a Unified Security Stack
items.summary: Microsoft's Project Perception adds Guardian Agents to monitor and contain anomalous AI agents, but experts warn that policing unpredictable agents with other agents may compound — not contain — the risk.

items.title: State Bank of India Suffers a Customer PII Data Leak
items.summary: Relatively small data breaches in India can turn quite serious, thanks to a sophisticated underground market for trading PII.

items.title: Microsoft Links Storm-0940 to ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: The China-linked actor used an AI-enabled penetration-testing tool to automate and accelerate its attack on more than 2,200 tenants.

items.title: What We Missed: Feds Lasso Texas Laptop Farms
items.summary: In this video, Dark Reading editors discuss some of the news they didn't get a chance to cover, from busting up North Korea's stateside infrastructure in "Operation Lonestar Justice" to Staples' gift card bonanza.

items.title: Les supermarchés de l'UE paient d'un firmware de réfrigérateur non mis à jour
items.summary: Des centaines de magasins ont subi des pertes se chiffrant en millions d'euros parce qu'ils avaient fait appel à des tiers pour gérer le micrologiciel OT obsolète qui pilotait leurs systèmes de climatisation.

items.title: As AI Risks Grow, Insurers Split on Covering the Damage
items.summary: Some build specialized agentic AI coverage, while major carriers quietly exclude it — leaving enterprises exposed without their knowledge.

items.title: UAE Transitions 50% of Government Services to Agentic AI
items.summary: The United Arab Emirates says it's creating a foundation of security and safety as it transforms its public service footprint.

items.title: TiDB Breach Exposes Flawed Cloud Security Assumptions
items.summary: Cloud providers may be storing sensitive customer data, without either party knowing it. But when a provider is breached, the unseen information comes to light.

items.title: Marvell, Microsoft & Oracle Work to Standardize Data Center Hardware Security
items.summary: The effort is aimed at standardizing a NIST FIPS 140-3 Level 3 integrated HSM for cloud and hyperscale data center infrastructure.

items.title: Cloud Security Alliance Survey Finds Data Loss Prevention Often Detects Data Loss Only After It Happens
items.summary: Research finds that, among respondents experiencing data loss, only 16% said DLP blocked their most significant incidents before data left the organization.

items.title: 'PHP2Shell' Bugs Signal Red Alert for Security Industry
items.summary: Security teams are scrambling to remediate two critical PHP vulnerabilities following leaked details and reports of exploitation attempts.

items.title: OVHcloud GitHub Compromise Tied to GlassWorm Threat Actors
items.summary: A developer's GitHub account that was compromised several months earlier was used to push malicious code to unsuspecting users.

items.title: Optiv Launches CyberBOT Cybersecurity Awareness Training Program
items.summary: Hands-on sessions provide educators, nonprofits, and community leaders with an accessible resource to foster year-round cyber awareness and build more resilient communities.

items.title: Survey Finds High-Profile Executives Feel Untouchable as Digital Exposure Turns Into Physical Risk
items.summary: 360 Privacy finds more than 8 in 10 security and wealth professionals say cybersecurity and physical security can no longer be separated.

items.title: Decades-Old Windows Utility Powers Modern ClickFix Attack
items.summary: The attack uses malicious Google search results related to Amazon and leverages the "finger" utility to launch a CAPTCHA that installs malware, including the Lumma stealer.

items.title: Tech Giants Block eMudhra Certificates Tied to 8 Compromised Keys
items.summary: Google, Mozilla, Apple, the Go project and others moved swiftly to block the affected certificates from the Indian CA, though it's unclear how the keys were compromised.

items.title: Ex-OpenAI Engineer Detained After Planting Secret Recorder at HQ
items.summary: The perp, who has Saudi ties, was arrested for allegedly bugging an OpenAI conference room, highlighting a preventable insider threat vector.

items.title: Close Identity Gaps in Software Development Before Unleashing AI
items.summary: Artificial intelligence is complicating security in the software development life cycle, but a Dark Reading roundtable found collaboration, better identity visibility, and reduced testing costs offer CISOs a way ahead.

items.title: Hackers Abuse AI Pen-Test Tool Cairn to Automate Massive Attack Spree
items.summary: A Chinese-speaking attacker has compromised hundreds of websites across the globe, looting from big fish like John Deere, SharkNinja, and engine manufacturer Cummins.

items.title: Researchers Infiltrate Microsoft Tech Support Scam Operation
items.summary: A large-scale scam operation impersonating Microsoft uses a malicious traffic distribution system (TDS) run by a Russian organization and abuses thousands of Cloudflare links.

items.title: 'AdFection' Turns Ad Impressions Into Zero-Click Spyware Delivery
items.summary: Spyware vendors are exploiting targeted ad bidding in the digital ecosystem to identify and track individuals and organizations of interest.

items.title: ConnectWise Disables Cloud Backups Amid Concerns for Downstream MSPs
items.summary: Researchers say attackers authenticated into Microsoft 365 tenants using ConnectWise credentials; ConnectWise says customer impact remains unconfirmed.

items.title: OnlyFans Copyright Takedowns Expose Compromised Websites
items.summary: Copyright takedown requests tied to OnlyFans and other adult content creators are revealing how attackers exploit vulnerable university and government websites to manipulate search results. UpGuard's Greg Pollock explains what universities, government websites, and security teams need to think about next.

items.title: The Evolving Cybersecurity Lexicon: Vulnerability Discovery to Resilience
items.summary: An industry-wide, laser focus on vulnerabilities has left cybersecurity teams without enough room to strategize for resilience.

items.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day Continues Trend of Exploited Edge Bugs
items.summary: Ivanti, Cisco, and Palo Alto Networks all had vulnerabilities in edge devices come under fire this week. Now BeyondTrust joins the group.
